title: Dimension lower bound for each rational closed-fibre component of a finite type algebra map
statement: Let $k$ be a field, let $B$ and $C$ be commutative finite type $k$-algebras [def-weil-pbc-finite-type-algebra], and suppose that $C$ is an integral domain. Let $\varphi:B\to C$ be a unital $k$-algebra homomorphism and put $P=\ker\varphi$. Let $\mathfrak m$ be a maximal ideal of $B$ such that the structure map $k\to B/\mathfrak m$ is an isomorphism. Set $J=(\varphi(b):b\in\mathfrak m)\subseteq C$, the ideal generated by the indicated elements. Then every irreducible component $W$ [def-weil-irreducible-components] of $\operatorname{Spec}(C/J)$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] satisfies $$\dim W\geq\dim C-\dim(B/P).$$ Here $\dim W$ is topological Krull dimension with the subspace topology [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], and the dimensions of rings are Krull dimensions [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring]. The ring dimensions on the right are finite nonnegative integers. If $C/J$ is the zero ring, the assertion about components is vacuous.
